description: Source code for CUDA communication operations in PyTorch, including tensor broadcasting, scattering, gathering, and coalescing across multiple devices.

classes.name: unique_type_checker
classes.description: Helper struct to check if all tensors are of a unique type during broadcasting operations.

methods.name: _broadcast_out_impl
methods.description: Performs tensor broadcasting to multiple CUDA devices, optionally using NCCL if available.

methods.name: broadcast_out
methods.description: Broadcasts a source tensor to a list of output tensors, with checks for CUDA device and shape consistency.

methods.name: broadcast
methods.description: Creates copies of a tensor on specified devices, handling device indices and memory formats.

methods.name: broadcast_coalesced
methods.description: Coalesces multiple tensors into larger chunks, broadcasts them across devices, and re-wraps variables with individual version counters.

methods.name: scatter_out
methods.description: Scatters a tensor across multiple CUDA tensors along a specified dimension, with optional streams.

methods.name: scatter
methods.description: Splits a tensor into chunks and moves each chunk to specified devices, with optional streams.

methods.name: _gather_out_impl
methods.description: Gathers a list of tensors into a single output tensor along a specified dimension.

methods.name: gather_out
methods.description: Prepares an output tensor and gathers multiple tensors into it along a specified dimension.

methods.name: gather
methods.description: Creates a tensor by concatenating a list of tensors along a specified dimension, with optional destination device.
